Class AddressUtilsTest

@IsTest()
private class AddressUtilsTest

Unit tests for the AddressUtils class. Validates address parsing via mocked Gemini API responses and address formatting for both successful and error scenarios.

    Test Classes

  • 03/29/2026 - v1.3 - Method stateValidatorTest() moved from BlazeBiteToolsTest.
